_meta.label: SAMPLE DATA - for development and testing only
_meta.disclaimer: These entries are short, simplified summaries written for testing the app. They are NOT an official or complete record and may be incomplete or out of date. Always confirm details on the official source link before acting. Replace this file with data ingested from verified government sources before any real deployment.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.summary: Income support for landholding farmer families, paid directly into the bank account.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 each, roughly every four months
Money is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account
eligibility_text: Farmer family that owns cultivable agricultural land
Certain higher-income and institutional categories are excluded (for example income-tax payers) - check the official guidelines for the full list
how_to_apply: Register on the official PM-KISAN portal, or visit a Common Service Centre (CSC)
You can also contact your local agriculture / revenue officer
Keep Aadhaar, land records and bank details ready

criteria.label: Your family owns cultivable agricultural land

exclusions.label: You do not pay income tax

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (health cover)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Authority)
schemes.summary: Health insurance cover for hospital treatment for eligible families, and for senior citizens aged 70 and above.
benefits: Cashless hospital treatment cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals
Senior citizens aged 70 and above are covered under the extension of the scheme
eligibility_text: Families identified through the scheme's deprivation and occupation criteria (use the official portal to check whether you are listed)
required_documents: Ration card or proof of family listing (as asked)
how_to_apply: Check your name or family on the official PM-JAY portal or helpline
Visit an empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk or a CSC to complete verification and get the card
Details for senior citizens are on the official portal

criteria.label: You are aged 70 or above, OR your family is listed as eligible under PM-JAY

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (girl child savings)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs)
schemes.summary: A small-savings account for the future education and marriage expenses of a girl child.
benefits: Long-term savings account in the girl child's name with a government-notified interest rate (the rate changes - check the current rate officially)
Deposit limits apply per financial year; see the official rules
eligibility_text: Account is opened in the name of a girl child, usually before she turns 10
Opened by a parent or legal guardian
required_documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
ID and address proof of the parent or guardian
how_to_apply: Visit any post office or authorised bank that offers the scheme
Fill in the account opening form and submit the documents with the first deposit

criteria.label: You have a girl child under 10 years of age

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.summary: A pension scheme mainly for workers in the unorganised sector, with a fixed monthly pension after age 60.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 from age 60, depending on the amount and age at which you start contributing
eligibility_text: Must have a savings bank account
Income-tax payers are not eligible to join (rule in force since October 2022)
how_to_apply: Visit the bank branch where you have a savings account, or use your bank's net-banking / mobile app if offered
Choose your pension amount and contribution frequency

criteria.label: You are at least 18 years old
You have a savings bank account

exclusions.label: You do not pay income tax

schemes.source_name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority

schemes.name: PM Mudra Yojana (small business loans)
schemes.summary: Collateral-free loans for small and micro non-farm businesses, given through banks and other lenders.
benefits: Loans up to Rs 10 lakh without collateral
Three categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to 5 lakh), Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to 10 lakh)
eligibility_text: Individuals or small enterprises running or starting a non-farm income-generating business such as a shop, workshop or service
required_documents: Business plan or proof of the activity
how_to_apply: Apply at a bank, NBFC or microfinance institution that offers Mudra loans
Use the official Mudra portal to find participating lenders

criteria.label: You run or plan a small non-farm business

schemes.name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (basic bank account)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
schemes.summary: A zero-balance basic bank account with a debit card and insurance benefit for people who do not have a bank account.
benefits: Basic savings account with no minimum balance
RuPay debit card with accident insurance cover
Direct transfer of government benefits into the account
eligibility_text: Any individual aged 10 or above who does not already have a bank account
required_documents: Aadhaar or other officially valid ID
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or a Bank Mitra / business correspondent
Fill the account opening form with your KYC documents

criteria.label: You are at least 10 years old
You do not yet have a bank account

schemes.name: MGNREGA (rural wage employment)
schemes.summary: A legal guarantee of wage employment for rural households whose adult members are willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per rural household in a financial year
Wages are paid to the worker's bank or post office account
eligibility_text: Adult member (18+) of a rural household
Willing to do unskilled manual work
The household must register with the Gram Panchayat and get a job card
required_documents: Proof of identity / residence for the Gram Panchayat
Bank or post office account details
how_to_apply: Apply for a job card at your Gram Panchayat
Then submit a written or oral application for work to the Gram Panchayat

criteria.label: You are an adult (18 or above)
You live in a rural area
You are willing to do unskilled manual work
